verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's fraud-prevention docs include a 'Create risk rules and lists' section and fraud reports, and its testing docs cover fraud detection, so custom risk rules are a first-party capability. The evidence is only section titles: it never mentions machine-learning fraud scores or the specific block/review/allow rule actions. Missing for 10: evidence of ML-based fraud scoring per transaction, documented block/review/allow rule outcomes, finance-ops-facing rule-builder detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
